text_markup: The Corp is playing {card:Near-Earth Hub} and uses the ability on {card:Tech Startup} to search their deck for an asset and install it. After finding the asset, R&D must be immediately shuffled before the Corp installs the asset or triggers {card:Near-Earth Hub}'s ability.
